description: ses_mailer.rs is_transient_ses_error(): the final arm 'unknown variants default to transient' means any future AWS SDK error variant will cause a retry loop rather than dead-lettering. This is the safe default but should have a comment explaining why — otherwise maintainers may change it to 'false' thinking it is a bug. P3 doc/readability.
title: SesMailer: SdkError unknown variant defaults to transient (safe but worth documenting)
